NORAD ID: 35942

Launch date: September 30, 2009

Amazonas 2 was built by Astrium based on its Eurostar E3000 satellite bus, for on-orbit delivery in 2009. Amazonas 2 will be operated from at 61° West, providing relay services with 54 Ku band and 10 C band transponders.
